title: In-Advance Prediction of Pressure Ulcers via Deep-Learning-Based Robust Missing Value Imputation on Real-Time Intensive Care Variables.
summary: AUROC .945 on-time and .912 at 48 hours; external AUROC improved after rescaling/fine-tuning. MIMIC-IV and KNUH data; external results depend on adaptation, so not untreated transportability.
ai_technology: GRU-D++ predicts ICU pressure-ulcer occurrence from time series with missing-data handling.
organization: Department of Research & Development, Ziovision Co., Ltd., Chuncheon 24341, Republic of Korea
